description: This file is a C header file defining macros, inline functions, and including external libraries related to safe string and memory operations, primarily for secure coding practices in C. It also contains licensing information and conditional compilation for a dummy API implementation.

methods.name: parseFormat
methods.description: A static inline function that formats a string with variable arguments, returning 1 if successful, 0 otherwise.

methods.name: strcmp_s
methods.description: A static inline function that compares two strings safely, returning an error code and setting the result.

methods.name: strcasecmp_s
methods.description: A static inline function that compares two strings case-insensitively, returning an error code and setting the result.

methods.name: memcmp_s
methods.description: A static inline function that compares two memory blocks safely, returning an error code and setting the result.
